entities.summary: Galtieri, a notable figure in the history of Argentina, associated with The Dirty War, Malvinas/Falklands, and Democratic Restoration (1982–1982). Preceded by 1978 FIFA World Cup held in Argentina amid state terrorism and Mothers of the Plaza de Mayo begin marching — April 30, 1977. Their legacy influenced Alfonsín elected president — October 30, 1983 and Trial of the Juntas — top military leaders convicted, 1985.
